title: "MSc Competitor analysis"
author: "Andy & Dom"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(DT)
library(tidyverse)

# filter courses by these keywords
keywords <- c("Accounting", "Actuarial", "Algorithms", "Biology", "Biotechnology", "Biological", "Biomedical", "Bus", "Business", "Communicat", "Computing", "Ecology", "Econ", "Economics", "ECONOMICS", "Energy", "Engineering", "Environ", "Environment", "Environmental", "Finance", "Financial", "Fintech", "Genom", "Genomics", "Geo-Energy", "Geographic", "Journalism", "Law", "Management", "Marketing", "Mrkting", "Mathematics", "Media", "Narrative", "Networking", "Petroleum", "Pharmacology", "Politics", "Privacy", "Protection", "Satellite", "Security", "Total", "Transport") 
pattern <- str_c("\\b(", str_c(keywords, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")

# grab and wrangle data
msc_tib <- here::here("data/competing_mscs.xlsx") |> 
  readxl::read_xlsx(skip = 2,
                    col_names = c("provider", "course", "20/21", "21/22", "22/23", "23/24", "24/25")) |> 
  filter(!str_detect(course, pattern)) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `20/21`:`24/25`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "n"
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(n))

```
